data.one_liner: A widget that measures the rendering size of its child dynamically.
data.what_it_does: MeasureSizeBuilder wraps a child widget and provides its dynamically computed size through a builder function. It detects when the widget size changes and can return updated size values in real time based on a configurable sensitivity duration.
use_when: You need to access the dynamic width or height of a widget at runtime
You want to conditionally alter UI layout or styling based on a widget's measured size
avoid_when: You only need standard layout constraints without explicitly reading pixel dimensions
strengths: Easy to use with a builder pattern
Detects changed size dynamically when child widgets change
Configurable sensitivity duration to control update frequency
weaknesses: Frequent size changes and short sensitivity durations can trigger excessive widget re-renders
